tasks.title: Scope peer invalidation to the retired session
tasks.acceptanceCriteria: Correct review 85711214 P2 stale-tab invalidation. A terminal old-session notification must clear only matching session/service peers, never a newer valid session draft or its original-operation references. Use only existing nonsecret session/service associations in a closed bounded notification; omit operator identity, credentials, Configuration values and operation references. Capture the retired association before clearing local context. Preserve matching peer signout, authoritative focus checks, unavailable masking, idempotence, clock rules, owner limits and actual callback custody. Ignore legacy unscoped/malformed notifications. No new endpoint, auth framework, polling, screen, package or pin.
tasks.validation: Use production coordinator, protected owner and receipt store for old expiry and changed-context notifications, matching-peer invalidation, newer draft/reference preservation and malformed/wrong-service boundaries. Extend the existing actual two-tab native fixture with a finite newer-session draft preservation journey while retaining real signout/operator-change/held-response/no-effect assertions. Existing fixture owners must join all work. Include pinned build, affected tests, documentation and independent review within this leaf; no push, merge, release or Ubuntu CI claim.

tasks.title: Suspend native Deploy modality during session verification
tasks.acceptanceCriteria: Correct review 85711214 P2 inaccessible session Retry behind a hidden native Deploy modal. Close or suspend actual native modality while verification is checking/unavailable, retaining the selected immutable version and deployment note in component state. Restore only after successful validation of the same session. Keep true identity/target invalidation, real cancel/Escape behavior, current native assignment authority and original-operation/cleanup custody. Do not remount the page or clear deployment state merely to mask it. Block deployment admission during verification including live checks around awaited preview.
tasks.validation: Extend the existing native Save/Deploy/rollback journey: open Deploy with a note, hold/fail actual focus verification, assert native dialog is not modal/open, activate Retry by actual pointer then keyboard, and restore the exact selection/note after same-session verification with zero preview/assignment effects for those checks. Keep native commit/Operations/Audit assertions for the normal journey and actual response/CDP/page cleanup. Include pinned production build, affected tests, scoped C# format/build, concise docs and independent review; no new screen/framework/package/runtime pin, push, merge or release.
